title: Renewal Loyalty Program Terms: Gas Service Charge on a True-Up Line After Estimated Reads
content:
# Gas Service Charge on the True-Up Line — Utility Services Program Loyalty Terms

**Term.** On a Utility Services Program gas true-up line, the gas service charge is set by the estimate run and the lease's renewal record:

1. It is **waived** (a share of 0) when the estimated gas reads number **at least 2** and the lease has **at least 3** renewal rent changes on record.
2. It is **halved** (a share of 0.5) when the estimated gas reads number **at least 2** and the lease has **at least 1 but fewer than 3** renewal rent changes on record.
3. In every other situation the **whole** monthly fixed gas service charge of the program applies.

The gas service charge is rounded half up to the cent.

**Records read.** The estimated gas reads are those on the utility account dated fewer than three whole months before the billing date. Renewal rent changes are the rent changes recorded with the reason renewal on the Lease Term Agreement records of the lease.

## Grid

| Estimated gas reads in the window | Renewal rent changes on record | Gas service charge on the line |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 3 or more | waived |
| 2 or more | 1 or 2 | one half |
| 2 or more | 0 | whole |
| 0 or 1 | any number | whole |

## Worked cases (hypothetical monthly charge of $7.00)

- Two estimated reads, four renewals: $0.00.
- Two estimated reads, two renewals: $3.50.
- One estimated read, five renewals: $7.00.
